Inclusion Criteria:
For the two retrospective cohorts:
  1

right.raw_text:
All patients that older than 18 treated for localized adenocarcinoma of the prostate between 2000 and 2017 with either radical prostatectomy  [OR] or radiotherapy
  2

left.raw_text: All treated patients had a rising post-treatment PSA, [AND]  with at least one post-treatment free PSA blood test

right.raw_text: All patients treated with radical prostatectomy  [AND] for localized prostate cancer between 2000 and 2017 who had biobank samples taken when developing biochemical recurrence

Patients with prostate cancer other than adenocarcinoma, such as small cell  [OR] and neuroendocrine cancer
  3

left.raw_text: Patients with prostate adenocarcinoma  [AND] that did not develop biochemical recurrence

right.raw_text: In the retrospective cohorts - patients that did not have at least one post-treatment free PSA blood test
